scenes.description: Intro hook showing Quebec's scale. Starts with a close-up of the map, zooms out to show North America, and overlays various facts like lakes, whales, and craters.

Multiple photo frames pop up with bounce effect

scenes.build_notes: Use Remotion's Interpolate to handle the zoom_out over the first 10 seconds. Mapbox center should move slightly south as it zooms.

scenes.description: Fact #1: Size and scale. Compares Quebec to France, Germany, Iran, and Libya. Shows neighbors (Ontario, USA) and climate zones (Montreal to Nunavik).
scenes.layout: Dynamic map-focused. Overlays appear based on the region mentioned.
element_animations: White distance arrow scales across the map
France/Germany silhouettes drop onto Quebec map
Neighboring provinces/states pulse and change color when named
Red circles highlight Montreal and Nunavik
scenes.build_notes: This is a long scene. Use a timeline or switch statement to control map camera movements linked to the voiceover timestamps (e.g., pan south when mentioning US states).

audio_hints.voice_lines: Le Québec c'est un monstre géographique... plus de 1,6 millions de km2... trois fois la France... du sud de Montréal jusqu'à Nunavik...

scenes.description: Fact #2: The St. Lawrence River skeleton. An anatomical spine graphic is overlaid on the river to illustrate its role as the 'backbone' of the province.
scenes.layout: Close up on the river, spine overlaid
element_animations: Spine vertebrae appear one by one along the river path
scenes.build_notes: Use a GeoJSON path for the river and animate an SVG along that path for the spine.
